desc: Derive and prove the all-pairs feasibility condition and its equivalent propagated-upper-envelope formula for maximum feasible \(H\).
Compute \(\min_j(U_j+X|i-j|)\) in \(O(N)\) using left-to-right and right-to-left sweeps.
Prove the grinding cost is \(\sum_i(U_i+D_i)-N H_{\max}\), including nonnegativity validity.
Implement the \(O(N)\) Python solution with stdin/stdout and arbitrary-size integer arithmetic.
